# E0.8: negative control, 10% of the mix replaced by white noise

Status: planned
Owner: Naresh
Dates: planned 2026-10-29 / started YYYY-MM-DD / finished YYYY-MM-DD

## Part A. Written BEFORE the run (do not edit after the run starts)

**Gap / phase:** Phase 0 (controls)

**Hypothesis (one sentence):** diluting B0 with 10% i.i.d. white-noise rows makes the fast dev score worse by a measurable
amount at 5M; the size says how much a share change alone costs (every family added at 3-10% later dilutes B0 the same way).

**Change (exact config diff against B0):**
```
generator version: v0
switches: white_noise {share: 0.10, mode: add} (tideforge/gen/ext/e08_noise.py: passthrough, N(0, 1) rows)
mix weights: every B0 family loses 10% of its rows in proportion
anything else: recipe ab5m_cpm, seed 0
```

**Run id(s):** E0.8-v0-white_noise-1738106a-t2deea6b0-s0-<code version at submit>

**What should move:**
- Probe: all, slightly worse (less data of every kind).
- Dev slice: overall and every domain slightly worse.
- Expected direction and rough size: worse, by less than 10% of the points' value (most of what is lost is redundant data);
  a guess, no number to compare with.

**Win rule:** none (control). Recorded: the change vs E0.7's 3-seed mean, against E0.7's spread.

**What would make this a failure:** a change inside E0.7's spread (then 5M cannot see a 10% dilution, and family shares of 3-5%
need more seeds or more points to show anything: say so before Phase 2).

**Cost estimate:** 1 x 100B points, in the 4th GPU slot of the t3_e07 node job.
